explanation: Nonvertebrate chordates are chordate organisms that do not have a spine composed of bony vertebrae. They include: 1) Lancelets (cephalochordates), which are marine chordates that maintain all 4 characteristics of chordates for their entire life; and 2) Sea squirts (urochordates), also known as tunicates, which possess an outer, tunic-like covering. In sea squirts, only the free-swimming larva possesses all 4 chordate characteristics. A phylogenetic tree of all chordates is referenced here.
